title: Samora Machel Avenue
description: A major arterial thoroughfare framing iconic high-rises, corporate HQs, and bustling urban commerce.

title: Harare Gardens
description: The largest public park in central Harare featuring lush lawns, tree-lined walkways, and a bandstand.

title: National Heroes Acre
address: Off Bulawayo Road, west of Harare
description: A national monument and burial ground honoring heroes of Zimbabwe's liberation struggle set on a scenic hill.

title: Mbare Musika Market
description: One of the busiest traditional markets in the country known for fresh produce, crafts, and daily trade.

title: Epworth Balancing Rocks
description: Remarkable natural geological formations illustrating balanced granite rocks sculpted by weathering over millennia.

title: Mukuvisi Woodlands
description: A protected urban nature reserve offering tranquil walking trails, wildlife viewing, and environmental education.

title: Eastgate Centre
description: An architectural marvel inspired by termite mounds, utilizing innovative biomimetic passive cooling design.

title: Lake Chivero
description: A scenic recreational lake supplying the city's water, popular for boating, fishing, and birdwatching.
